    ``````markdown
    ## Reason for This Test

Then navigate to http://127.0.0.1:43117/posts/beta-guide and reload the page. Confirm that inside the element with attribute data-testid="post-body" there is a <strong> element whose text is 'beta updated'. The verification passes only if the updated bold text is present after reload.

    ## Result Format
    At the end of the test, respond with the following JSON:
    {
        "status": "pass" | "fail",
        "reason": "A detailed explanation of why the test passed or failed."
    }
    ``````
2. Report the result of the `browser` sub-agent in JSON format. If the sub-agent fails or does not return a result, report the status as `fail` and provide the reason.
